metadata.name: ballast
metadata.description: The Ballast program: class verification, launch registry, prediction record, vault, floor, bids, redemption, burns, fee routing (§3, §6).

instructions.name: burn_leftover
docs: §6 `burn_leftover()`: after migration, withdraw DBC's leftover base into `partner_auth`'s ATA
(skipped if a third party already did — DBC can only pay that ATA), pull the partner surplus
into the vault, and burn everything in the ATA. The `Migrated` observation and the move to
`Cleaned` happen here together (§5).

instructions.name: create_class
docs: §6 `create_class(size_tag)`. Admin signs and pays. Validates the DBC `PoolConfig` field by
field against §7, each rule with its own error code, then records the class immutably.

accounts.name: admin
docs: §19: only the multisig admin creates classes. §6 lists the admin as the sole signer, so the
admin also pays — no extra payer signer is introduced.

accounts.name: dbc_config

instructions.name: initialize_global
docs: §6 `initialize_global(admin)`; the treasury is passed as an account, not an argument.
The signer must be the program's **upgrade authority**. Without that constraint the
instruction is open between §19 runbook step 1 (deploy from a buffer) and step 3 (this
call), and whoever calls it first takes `global.admin` and `global.treasury` permanently —
there is no admin setter and `init` makes the legitimate call fail. That would falsify
§19's "exactly two authorities exist, both a 2-of-3 multisig".

accounts.name: deployer
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority — otherwise this instruction is open between
deployment and §19 runbook step 3, and admin/treasury are permanently takeable.

instructions.name: register_launch
docs: §6 `register_launch(creator_beneficiary)`, as amended by D-011: the last instruction of the
single launch transaction. Verifies the transaction by introspection and DBC/DLMM state,
records the prediction, and creates the vault. No funds move.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The original DBC pool creator: sets `creator_beneficiary`, so it must sign.

instructions.name: settle_graduation
docs: §6 `settle_graduation()`: once the curve is complete, move the partner migration fee and the
partner trading fees into the vault, each measured as a balance delta. Valid before or after
migration (§5 keeper lag). Partner flows only (D-022): the creator's trading fees stay in DBC
for `pay_creator`, so nothing the creator controls can block graduation.

types.name: BackingDecreased
docs: §8 fail-safe, one per position and per decrease.

types.name: BidCapped
docs: D-020: the bid rests at the DLMM active bin, below F's bin, because a third-party order pins the
active bin. Still a bid at or below F.

types.name: BidSuspended
docs: D-021: the active bin is pinned more than 70 bins under F's bin; the vault rests unplaced, V
still counts it and redemption stays live.

types.name: Class
docs: §5: a verified DBC config plus the prediction parameters. Immutable once created.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: The DBC `PoolConfig` this class is pinned to.

fields.name: config_hash
docs: `sha256` over the canonical curve fields (§7 rule 3).

fields.name: predicted_s_open
docs: Lower bound on `s` at `open`, from the compiler (§7). `u128` = Q64 sqrt price.

fields.name: bid_bin_step
docs: D-014: fixed per class. The DLMM pair address carries no bin step, so there is one pair per
mint pair and this value cannot be changed later.

fields.name: dust_limit
docs: D-011(b): the payer's dust first buy in the launch transaction must not exceed this.

types.name: CreatorPaid
docs: D-022: creator income paid to `ATA(creator_beneficiary, WSOL)`.

fields.name: dbc_fees
docs: DBC creator trading fees.

fields.name: lp_fees
docs: The creator position's DAMM v2 LP fees (0 before `Open`).

fields.name: order
docs: The resting order (default while the DLMM leg is suspended).

fields.name: burned
docs: Base burned from staging: the fill plus anything sent there from outside.

fields.name: quote_returned
docs: Quote the cancel returned to the vault: unfilled + DLMM fees.

types.name: Global
docs: §5: admin (a multisig), treasury, class-creation switch. Initialised once.

fields.name: admin
docs: The 2-of-3 multisig (§19). Can create classes and toggle creation — nothing else.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury WSOL token account, receiving 10% of harvested partner LP fees (§6 `harvest`).

fields.name: migration_fee
docs: Partner migration fee → vault (§10: 15% of the threshold).

fields.name: partner_fees
docs: Partner DBC trading fees → vault. (The creator's fees are `pay_creator`'s, D-022.)

fields.name: base_burned
docs: Base fees burned from staging (0 under the class's QuoteToken fee mode).

types.name: Launch
docs: §5: one launch. Never closed — it is the public proof record.

fields.name: creator_beneficiary
docs: Receives creator income at its WSOL ATA, through `pay_creator` only (D-022) — never on the
floor's critical path. Set by the signing creator.

fields.name: predicted_s
docs: The on-chain prediction (§7): `class.predicted_s_open`, recorded in the pool-creation
transaction before any third-party trade (D-011).

fields.name: s_last
docs: Only state cached across instructions (§4 code rule 2): the monotone check's last `s`.

fields.name: migration_fee
docs: `settle_graduation`: the partner migration fee and partner trading fees moved to the vault.

fields.name: leftover_burned
docs: `burn_leftover`: leftover base units burned and partner surplus moved to the vault.

fields.name: last_refresh_slot
docs: `refresh_floor` rate limit (§6): slot of the last refresh.

fields.name: l_open
docs: L at `open`. A later live read below it is §8's `BackingDecreased` fail-safe.

fields.name: degraded
docs: §8 fail-safe: set once L reads below `l_open`; the monotone check is then suspended.

fields.name: bid_capped
docs: D-020: the resting bid sits at the DLMM active bin, below F's bin, because a third-party order
pinned the active bin. Still a bid at or below F; any `refresh_floor` lifts it once cleared.

fields.name: bid_suspended
docs: D-021: the vault rests unplaced because the DLMM active bin is pinned more than 70 bins under
F's bin (or where DLMM has no price). V still counts the vault; redemption stays live. While
set, `bid_bin_id` is the pinned active bin and `bid_order` is default.

fields.name: fill_quote_spent
docs: §10 ledger (audit 7 Oct): quote the bid spent on fills, net of the fees DLMM credits back
(committed − returned on each cancel).

fields.name: partner_l_recorded
docs: §8 fail-safe (audit 7 Oct): each recorded position's L, lowered when a decrease is observed so
every further decrease emits its own `BackingDecreased`.

fields.name: predicted_s
docs: The on-chain prediction, recorded in the pool-creation transaction before any third-party
trade (D-011).

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: §25: the launch's DBC pool.

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units burned (S falls by exactly this).

fields.name: surplus
docs: Partner surplus → vault.
